title: Streaming transition latency inspector and blended SLI dashboard
creator: Aisha Gupta
description: Build a dashboard and supporting pipeline for inspecting latency percentiles (p50/p95/p99) broken down by model and route with a special focus on streaming vs non-streaming (blocking) paths and the transition period when streams are initialized. Includes tracing hooks to correlate high-percentile spikes with traces and an ingestion strategy for percentiles and distribution histograms.
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard exposes p50/p95/p99 by model and route with a toggle for streaming vs non-streaming within the same view
Ability to slice by request shape: token_count_bucket, prompt_tokens, and user-configured tags
Initial token latency and steady-state streaming latency shown separately (stream warmup view)
Percentiles computed consistently across 1m and 5m windows and stored for fast queries
Tracing link from any high-percentile cell to the top 5 related traces in the trace archive
Alerting rules for p95/p99 regressions per-model-route with mute windows for known rollouts
Dashboard refresh time under 60s for standard 1h/24h ranges
technical_notes: Instrumentation: add io_mode tag (streaming|nonstreaming), stream_phase (init|steady), model_name, route, sequence_length_bucket at runtime entry and exit points
Metrics pipeline: emit HDR histograms per (model_name, route, io_mode, stream_phase, region) at ingest and roll up to per-minute aggregates to avoid heavy cardinality on query time
Decision trade-off: compute percentiles at ingestion using streaming HDR aggregator to keep dashboards fast and consistent; keep raw samples and compact histograms for forensic analysis
Tracing: add trace_id -> request_id mapping to logs and include trace context in first token event for easy correlation
Storage: store per-minute histogram blobs in metrics-store and precompute p50/p95/p99 in materialized tables for Grafana/Loky queries
Downsampling: keep full histogram for last 7 days, daily aggregates for 30d, and percentiles/summary for 90d
implementation_plan: 1) Runtime instrumentation changes and tests (add tags and stream_phase) - short PR
2) Metrics pipeline change: update ingest aggregator to compute HDR histograms and export percentile keys
3) Storage/migrate: add new materialized table and backfill 7 days of histograms for top models
4) Grafana dashboard: design panels for model/route table, heatmap of stream warmup vs steady-state, percentile timeseries and latency cohort explorer
5) Tracing hooks: expose quick link from metrics cell to trace-search with query params (model, route, timeframe, percentile bucket)
6) QA and rollout: Canary on internal org, enable alerting, postmortem on rollout impact
